title: ConstantSubsheafLowerImageStalks
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space, $\iota:K\to C$ a monomorphism of abelian sheaves, and $\alpha:C\simeq\underline{\mathbb Z}$ an isomorphism to the constant integer sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Let $n,b\in\mathbb N$, opens $A_i$ and labels $0<c_i\leq b+1$ for $i\in\operatorname{Fin}(n)$, and an epimorphism $g:\bigoplus_i j_{A_i!}\underline{\mathbb Z}\to K$ [def-sc-abelian-open-extension-by-zero]. Assume that the image $s_i$ of the canonical unit section under the $i$th component of $g$ maps under $\alpha\iota$ to the constant section $c_i$, and that at every point of $U=\bigcup_i A_i$ an active label divides all active labels. Define $f$ on the same coproduct by its $i$th component equal to the $i$th component of $g$ if $c_i\leq b$, and zero otherwise. Put $L=\operatorname{im}(f)$, $l:L\to K$ its canonical inclusion, and $V=\bigcup_{c_i\leq b}A_i$. For arbitrary stalk isomorphisms $e_x:C_x\simeq\mathbb Z$ [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk], the image $e_x\iota_xl_x(L_x)$ has nonnegative generator at most $b$. The stalk of $\operatorname{coker}(l)$ is zero on $V$ and outside $U$. The stalk of $L$ is zero outside $V$.

proof.text:
The stalk functor is exact and preserves coproducts and images. A summand
vanishes outside A i and has integer stalk inside A i. By hsection and hvalue its map
into C sends 1 to c i in canonical integer coordinates. Therefore the stalk image of f
is generated by precisely the active labels at most b. If none is active it is zero;
otherwise its positive gcd divides an active label and is at most b. Automorphisms
between canonical coordinates and e are signs, which preserve these subgroups. On V
an active low label exists. The attained divisor supplied by hgcd divides it and hence
is also at most b. It generates the whole K stalk, so l is an isomorphism on V. Outside
U all generating summands and K vanish. Exactness then makes the cokernel stalk zero
on V and outside U. Outside V all components of f are zero, so its image stalk is zero.
This also treats b=0 and the empty family. Mathlib tools: the finite-limit and finite-colimit preservation instances for the sheaf stalk functor in Mathlib.Topology.Sheaves.Abelian, and the image factorization in an abelian category. Integer subgroup generators are given by Int.subgroup_cyclic; a positive divisor of an active low label is bounded by that label.
